title: 第1章 回家过年第2章 突变第3章 雪夜奔逃
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
寒风凛冽，漫天雪花飞舞，一个眉清目秀的小男孩站在门口的房檐下问道“娘！我们什么时候回家呀？爹爹肯定在家里面等着我们了！”房间里面传来一个极其温柔的女声说道“然儿！今天得风雪太大了！你外公外婆让我们等明天风雪停了再回去！”紧接着一位三十多岁的少妇，手里拿着一个暖手炉，来到那男孩身边，伸出手爱怜的摸了摸男孩的脸颊，顺便把男孩带到房间里面！
小男孩跟着少妇来到碳盆那里，他伸出小手烤了起来！少妇说道“然儿是不是想爹爹了？”小男孩点了点头说道“娘！为什么到了过年要送礼给外公外婆呀？我们家那么多房间，干嘛不把外公外婆接到我们家去住呀？”少妇微笑着回答“然儿！过年的时候送礼给外公外婆是我们的传统，要知道感恩！外公外婆把娘扶养大，他们付出了很多，现在他们老了，娘长大了！要尽量让他们过的幸福！”小男孩歪着头说道“哦！我知道了！等我长大了也让爹和娘过的幸福！那为什么不把外公外婆接到我们一起去住呢？”少妇很有耐心的说道“这里是他们的家，他们不能离开这里！”娘俩一边烤着火一边聊着。房间外面风雪越来越大了！天色逐渐暗了下来。
一个丫鬟过来说道“小姐！老夫人让您带小少爷过去吃饭！”少妇说道“小兰！我知道了，你去告诉我娘，这就过去！”少妇给男孩穿上披风，她自己也穿了一件外套，她带着男孩来到餐厅，男孩立刻挣脱少妇的手，跑向坐在桌子旁边的一位五十多岁的贵妇人，一边跑一边喊着“外婆外婆！”那贵妇人高兴的伸出双手把男孩揽进怀里，双手不停的摸着男孩那粉嘟嘟的脸颊！坐在桌子旁边的一位老者说道“都快吃饭吧！明天就是年三十了，然儿就要回去过年了！”男孩说道“外公！明天雪停了以后，您和外婆和我们一起走好嘛？“老者呵呵一笑说道“然儿！我和你外婆的家在这里，明天你舅舅也要回来了，我们在等他，就像你爹爹等你回去是一样的！”男孩面露不悦的说道“好吧！反正用不了几天，我和爹娘还要过来给外公外婆磕头的！”两位老者哈哈大笑起来。餐厅里面一幅其乐融融的画面，老者对少妇说道“碧柔！你明天和然儿回去的时候，带两坛好酒给卓正刚，他前段时间也辛苦了，好好犒劳他一下，这可是三十年的上等女儿红！”少妇闻言说道“爹！娘！正刚从回来到现在一直忙，天天应酬不断，所以没及时过来看望二老，还望二老不要生气！”老者说道“我们理解正刚，不生气！反正你们大年初二就要过来拜年了！”这时小男孩拍了拍自己的小肚子说道“娘！我吃饱了！”两位老者看着男孩露出幸福的笑容！
第二天早上，院子里面到处都是雪，几个家丁正在管家的指挥下，清理路上的积雪！小男孩跑到院子里面高兴的喊道“娘！你快点出来啊！院子里面都是雪，你快出来和我玩雪呀！”只见少妇款步来到男孩身边，少妇今天穿的很讲究，一身粉梅色雪狐棉衣，芙蓉祥云百花褶裙，身披淡兰色的梅花衫，站立于茫茫雪地之中，仿佛与梅花融为了一体，打扮的也很漂亮，风髻露鬓，淡扫娥眉，皮肤细润如温玉，柔光若腻，樱桃小嘴不饰而红，娇艳若滴，腮边两缕发丝随风轻柔拂面，凭添几分诱人的风情，而那双亮晶晶水汪汪大眼睛，一直注视着院子里的男孩，充满了对男孩的溺爱！虽然已经三十多岁了，依然美得如同天仙！就见少妇轻声说道“然儿！不要把衣服弄脏了，吃完早餐我们就要回去了，衣服脏了就不好看了！”男孩乖巧的点了点头跑到少妇面前。少妇让一个家丁把男孩抱着，一直送到书房里面，只见老者正在书房里面手持毛笔，准备写对联！男孩说道“外公！你写什么呢？”老者放下手中毛笔说道“外公准备写对联呀！你娘过来了吗？我们一起去吃早饭，吃完早饭你和你娘还要赶路！”老者拉起男孩的手就向餐厅走去，吃完早餐以后，一辆马车已经停在大门口了！少妇带着男孩也来到大门口，两人跺了跺脚上的雪，就准备上车！老者对赶马车的说道“老蔡！昨天下雪路上估计结冰了，你一定要小心一点！”老蔡说道“老爷！您放心！我一点会小心的！”老者用慈祥目光的看着女儿和外孙上了马车！突然他说道“等一会！差点忘了，还有两坛上好女儿红没带上呢，管家，快去酒窖把酒搬两坛过来！”一个中年男子答应了一声，转身就进去了。
在等待的时候，突然听到一阵马蹄声传过来，而且越来越近，转眼就来到马车这里，就见马上坐着一位二十岁上下的年轻男子，只见那人俊美绝伦，脸如雕刻般五官分明，有棱有角的脸俊美异常。外表看起来好象放荡不拘，但眼里不经意流露出的精光让人不敢小看。一头乌黑茂密的头发，一双剑眉下却是一对迷人的桃花眼，充满了多情，让人一不小心就会沦陷进去。高挺的鼻子，厚薄适中的红唇这时却漾着另人目眩的笑容。白衣和黑发都飘飘逸逸，不扎不束，微微飘拂，显得很是帅气迷人！只见他翻身下马喊道“爹！”那老者微微点头说道“宇儿！你回来了！正好你姐和然儿要回去了，你先去和你姐说几句话吧！”那男子转身来到马车旁边，就见马车上的窗户打开，一个小脑袋探出来喊道“舅舅！”年轻男子摸了摸男孩冻的通红的小脸说道“然儿！想舅舅了没？”小男孩很肯定的点了点头说道“想了！然儿可想舅舅了！”年轻男子在小男孩鼻子上轻轻一挂说道“那你怎么不等舅舅回来再走呢？”小男孩一时语塞，不知道怎么回答了！马车里面那少妇把男孩抱了进去，对年轻男子说道“小宇！抓紧时间把你终身大事给定下来呀！爹和娘天天让我劝你，我耳朵都听出老茧了！”被唤作小宇的年轻男子略显尴尬的说道“知道了姐！每次回来爹和娘都说这事，我头都大了！”就在这时管家带着两个家丁搬着两坛酒走过来，他连忙趁这个机会岔开话题，随着老蔡“驾”的一声，马车缓慢的向前走去，年轻男子对老者说道“爹！外面太冷了，我们先回房间，反正他们一家过两天又要来给您和娘拜年！”老者和年轻男子一起回到房间。
content_en:
The cold wind was biting and snowflakes were flying all over the sky. A handsome little boy stood under the eaves at the door and asked, "Mom! When are we going home? Daddy must be waiting for us at home!" An extremely gentle female voice came from the room and said, "Ran'er! Today is the day. The snow is too heavy! Your grandparents asked us to wait until the snow stops tomorrow before going back!" Then a young woman in her thirties came to the boy with a hand warmer in her hand, reached out and touched the boy's cheek lovingly, and took the boy into the room!
The little boy followed the young woman to the charcoal basin. He stretched out his little hand and started roasting! The young woman said, "Ran'er, do you miss your father?" The little boy nodded and said, "Mom! Why do you give gifts to your grandparents during the Chinese New Year? We have so many rooms in our house, why don't we bring our grandparents to live in our house?" The young woman replied with a smile, "Ran'er! It is our tradition to give gifts to our grandparents during the Chinese New Year. We must be grateful! My grandparents raised my mother, and they paid for it. Now they are old and my mother has grown up! I want to make them happy as much as possible!" The little boy tilted his head and said, "Oh! I know! Let my father and mother live happily when I grow up!" The young woman said patiently, "This is their home, they can't leave here!" The wind and snow outside the room are getting bigger and bigger! The sky gradually darkened.
A maid came over and said, "Miss! The old lady asked you to take the young master over for dinner!" The young woman said, "Xiaolan! I understand, you go tell my mother and come over now!" The young woman put on a cloak for the boy, and she also wore a coat. She took the boy to the dining room. In the hall, the boy immediately broke away from the young woman's hand and ran to a lady in her fifties sitting next to the table, shouting "Grandma, grandma!" while running. The lady happily stretched out her hands to take the boy into her arms, and kept touching the boy's pink cheeks with her hands! An old man sitting next to the table said, "Let's eat quickly! Tomorrow is New Year's Eve, and Ran'er will go back to celebrate the New Year!" The boy said, "Grandpa! After the snow stops tomorrow, can you and grandma come with us?" The old man laughed and said, "Ran'er! Your grandma and I will Our home is here, and your uncle will be back tomorrow. We are waiting for him, just like your father is waiting for you to come back!" The boy said with an unhappy face, "Okay! In a few days, my parents and I will come over to kowtow to my grandparents!" The two old men laughed. There was a happy scene in the restaurant. The old man said to the young woman, "Bi Rou! When you go back with Ran'er tomorrow, bring two jars of good wine to Zhuo Zhenggang. He has worked hard some time ago, so reward him. This is thirty years of high-quality daughter Hong!" After hearing this, the young woman said, "Dad! Mother! Zhenggang has been busy since he came back. There are many activities every day, so I didn’t come to visit you in time, so I hope you won’t be angry!” The old man said, “We understand Zhenggang, don’t be angry! Anyway, you are coming to visit us on the second day of the Lunar New Year!” At this time, the little boy patted his belly and said, “Mom! I’m full!” The two old men looked at the boy with a happy smile!
The next morning, there was snow everywhere in the yard, and several servants were clearing the snow on the road under the command of the housekeeper! The little boy ran into the yard and shouted happily, "Mom! Come out quickly! The yard is full of snow. Come out and play with me in the snow!" I saw the young woman walking to the boy's side. The young woman was very well-dressed today, wearing a pink plum-colored snow fox cotton-padded coat with a lotus auspicious clouds. She is wearing a pleated skirt and a light blue plum blossom shirt. Standing in the vast snow, she seems to be integrated with the plum blossoms. She is also very beautifully dressed. She has a wind bun exposing her temples and her eyebrows are lightly swept. Her skin is as smooth as warm jade, soft and greasy, and her cherry mouth is red and delicate., the two strands of hair beside her cheeks were blowing gently in the wind, adding a bit of seductive charm, and those big, bright, watery eyes were always looking at the boy in the yard, full of doting on the boy! Although she is over thirty years old, she is still as beautiful as a fairy! The young woman said softly, "Ran'er! Don't get your clothes dirty. We are going back after breakfast. The clothes will not look good if they are dirty!" The boy nodded obediently and ran to the young woman. The young woman asked a servant to hold the boy and carry him to the study. The old man was holding a brush in the study, preparing to write couplets! The boy said, "Grandpa! What are you writing?" The old man put down the brush in his hand and said, "Grandpa is going to write a couplet! Is your mother here? Let's go have breakfast together. After breakfast, you and your mother have to go on the road!" The old man took the boy's hand and walked to the restaurant. After breakfast, a carriage had stopped at the gate! The young woman and the boy also came to the gate. They stamped the snow on their feet and prepared to get in the car! The old man said to the driver of the carriage, "Old Cai! It was snowing yesterday and the road was probably icy. You must be careful!" Lao Cai said, "Master! Don't worry! I will be careful!" The old man looked at his daughter and grandson with kind eyes as they got on the carriage! Suddenly he said, "Wait a minute! I almost forgot, there are still two jars of good daughter's wine that I haven't brought with me. Butler, go to the wine cellar and bring two jars of wine!" A middle-aged man agreed, turned around and went in.
While waiting, I suddenly heard the sound of horse hooves coming, getting closer and closer. I arrived at the carriage in a blink of an eye, and saw a young man of about twenty years old sitting on the horse. I saw that the man was extremely handsome, with a face as clear as a sculpture, and an angular face that was extremely handsome. He looks like wild and unrestrained on the outside, but the casual reveal in his eyes can't be underestimated. She has thick black hair and a pair of charming peach blossom eyes under her sword-shaped eyebrows, which are full of amorous feelings that make people fall in love with her if they are not careful. The tall nose and moderately thick red lips now revealed a dazzling smile. The white clothes and black hair are flowing and elegant, not tied up or tied up, and flowing slightly, looking very handsome and charming! He turned over and dismounted and shouted, "Dad!" The old man nodded slightly and said, "Yu'er! You're back! Just as your sister and Ran'er are going back, go and say a few words to your sister first!" The man turned around and came to the carriage. He saw the window on the carriage open, and a little head poked out and shouted, "Uncle!" The young man touched He touched the boy's cold and red face and said, "Of course! Do you miss your uncle?" The little boy nodded affirmatively and said, "Yes! Of course, you miss your uncle!" The young man gently touched the little boy's nose and said, "Then why don't you wait until your uncle comes back before you leave?" The little boy was speechless for a moment and didn't know how to answer! The young woman in the carriage took the boy in and said to the young man, "Xiaoyu! Take the time to decide on your life-long event! My father and mother ask me to advise you every day, and I can hear the calluses in my ears!" The young man, who was called Xiaoyu, said with a slight embarrassment, "I know, sister! Every time I come back, my father and mother talk about this, and my head gets big!" At this moment! The housekeeper came over with two servants carrying two jars of wine. He quickly took this opportunity to change the subject. With Lao Cai's "drive" sound, the carriage slowly moved forward. The young man said to the old man, "Dad! It's too cold outside. Let's go back to the room first. Anyway, their family will come to visit you and your mother in the next two days!" The old man and the young man returned to the room together.
